notes: Every case is a new chart; the clock is NOW = 1700000000000 at setOption and only {tick} steps advance it.
A click is mousedown, mouseup, click at one point; a drag is mousedown, mousemoves, mouseup, click.
Points named by a node were resolved on the picture of the time (an integer point the node is hit at) and are written as numbers.
events: the action events (sunburstroottonode, treemapzoomtonode, treemaproottonode, treemapmove, treemaprender), seriesId resolved to the index, targetNode to its dataIndex.

cases.note: click a root piece, then a piece of the drilled view, the view root itself (nothing), the return circle twice; a leaf; a resize keeps the view root
a series with no name: the return circle has no words; a drill to a node with value 0 hidden
radius [20, '80%'], startAngle 30, clockwise false, a level radius (levels are by absolute depth), cornerRadius 4, label rotate 'tangential' and align 'left'
nodeClick false on the series, 'rootToNode' on level 2 (item -> level -> series): a root piece does nothing, a level-2 piece drills; 'link' on an item without a link does nothing
sunburstRootToNode by id (the name), by targetNodeId, an unknown id, the root by the series name; on two sunbursts with no query and with a seriesIndex
tooltip and focus descendant after a drill: a piece, the return circle (dataIndex 0), the view root, off the chart
the drill-down transition with the default timings (update 500 cubicInOut, enter 1000 cubicOut): kept pieces and labels move, the return circle and new pieces grow r from r0, new labels fade
animationDurationUpdate 300, animationEasingUpdate 'linear', animationDuration 400, animationEasing 'quadraticOut', animationDelayUpdate 50; a drill by action then a roll-up by action
click a leaf (zoomToNode: centred, the size by estimateRootSize), then another; nodeClick on a node far out of view
zoomToNodeRatio 0.5 and a border / gap per level: estimateRootSize grows the root, the border terms and the clamp by scaleLimit max 2
a deep small leaf: zoomToNode makes the root several times the box; the default scaleLimit (max 5) caps it
a border / gap per level and no scaleLimit: the border terms of estimateRootSize reach the root size unclamped (zoom about 1.6)
a leaf a thousandth of the whole: estimateRootSize asks for a zoom of about 10, the default scaleLimit max 5 caps it
leafDepth 1: a click on a leaf root drills (rootToNode), again one level down, the breadcrumb root rolls up
nodeClick false (no zoom, no drill even on a leaf root under leafDepth); nodeClick 'link' with no link does nothing
the breadcrumb: zoom into a leaf, click the middle crumb (zoomToNode a), the root crumb (zoomToNode root: the default size)
the breadcrumb after a pan finds the node under the centre with the transforms of the last paint
treemapZoomToNode by id, treemapRootToNode by targetNodeId, an unknown id, the root back by the series name; a resize keeps the view root
a drag pans by treemapMove; moves of 3 px or less are dropped; the wheel zooms about the pointer (treemapRender); a click after a roam zooms to the node
scaleLimit {min 0.5, max 1.5} clamps the wheel; the clamp holds the rect where it is
roam 'move': the wheel does nothing, a drag pans
roam false with roamTrigger 'selfRect': a drag does nothing and its release, within 4 px, is a click
tooltip and emphasis: a leaf (its group dispatches: both rects lifted, z2 + 10), a parent through its border, the breadcrumb, off the chart
the zoomToNode transition (900 ms quinticInOut): the root group slides and grows, new nodes come in from the parent corner and fade
a zoom that grows the root: rects keep, scale and leave the view (made invisible at the end)
leafDepth 1: rootToNode drill (the deleted nodes fade, the new ones come in), a click while it runs does nothing, then a roll-up from the breadcrumb
zoomToNode 100 ms into the first render, its labels still fading in: the click drills; the kept labels' fade and the transition
leafDepth 1: a rootToNode drill 300 ms into the first render, the labels still fading in
a pan 100 ms into the first render, its labels still fading in: treemapMove renders again, the kept words at their rest at once

leafDepth 1, a short update and a long enter: a rootToNode drill, its new words still fading in when a pan (one move: one render) takes a2 out of the view -- the words of a1 at their rest at once, those of a2 fade on

animationDurationUpdate 400, animationEasing 'linear' (the treemap animates with animationEasing); a pan while it runs does nothing, after it pans and does not animate (the pointer leaves the canvas: no hover, whose state transition is not ported)
[R2-I1] the view's own roam dispatches (TreemapView._onPan / _onZoom): {type, from (its uid), seriesId, rootRect}, the drag's and the wheel's

guards.id: R1 the view root is a full turn on the second ring
R1 the return circle is r0 .. r0 + rPerLevel
R2 back at the root, the return circle is gone but containPixel at the centre stays true
R3 zoomToNode sizes the root by estimateRootSize and the clamp
R4 two moves dispatched, the small ones dropped
R4 the root moved by the two kept deltas
R5 treemapRender scales the root rect about the pointer
R6 a kept piece moves by cubicInOut from the first frame
R7 the root group slides by quinticInOut
R8 a click while the treemap animates does nothing
a drillDown event
a rollUp event
a ghost leaving
a treemap label fading in
a sunburst piece growing
a zoomToNode root larger than the box
a breadcrumb
a tooltip on the return circle
a blurred sunburst piece
a hovered treemap rect
